newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon posts $180 mln Jan-July BoP surplus.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon posts $180 mln Jan-July BoP surplus.

text.p: Lebanon posted a balance of payments suprlus of $180 million in the first seven months of 1996, the central bank said in a bulletin on Tuesday.

"The balance of payments improved due to an increase in capital inflows, especially investment capital, so the overall balance of payments posted a surplus of $180 million during the first seven months of this year," the Bank of Lebanon said.
The January-July surplus compared with a BoP deficit of $247 million in the same period last year, it said.

The Bank said the trade balance improved by 3.5 percent in the first seven months of 1996. Imports were $4.155 billion in July against $4.159 billion over 1995's corresponding period while exports grew by 29 percent to $556 million.
